TRACE-AUTHORITY-GREENFIELD-EMPTY-RACE.finiteDomain: One empty namespace, one authorization, two controllers, and one competing writer admission.
TRACE-AUTHORITY-GREENFIELD-EMPTY-RACE.resultProjection: Activation evidence, empty-world revision, exact replay, and the compare-and-set winner agree.

TRACE-AUTHORITY-LEGACY-CUTOVER-RACE.finiteDomain: Two controllers, one writer, one fence contender, one mismatch.
TRACE-AUTHORITY-LEGACY-CUTOVER-RACE.resultProjection: Monotonic state and CAS winner agree with the writer-fence abstraction.

TRACE-BOUNDED-FACADE-METAMORPHIC-CORPUS.finiteDomain: Receive 4 or 5; issue 1 or 2; transfer 1 or 2; exact terminal replay.
TRACE-BOUNDED-FACADE-METAMORPHIC-CORPUS.resultProjection: Independent arithmetic, event order, revision, and replay stutter agree.

TRACE-CATALOG-PUBLICATION-REPLAY.finiteDomain: One retained catalogue, append-only extensions, exact retries, conflicting definitions, and stale publication attempts.
TRACE-CATALOG-PUBLICATION-REPLAY.resultProjection: Published catalogue, replay, immutable revision retention, and rejection properties agree.
stateProjection: published-world catalogue root and event result

TRACE-COLLECTION-READ-IDENTITY.finiteDomain: Two immutable item members, one collection revision, exact per-member positions, and one roll-up summary.
TRACE-COLLECTION-READ-IDENTITY.resultProjection: Collection definition and summaries preserve exact member identity and never grant substitution authority.
stateProjection: collection revision, member positions, per-member and roll-up summary

TRACE-COMPOSITION-OPEN-REVISION.finiteDomain: Two immutable heterogeneous composition generations, one old-pack transfer/open, exact replay, and invalid opens.
TRACE-COMPOSITION-OPEN-REVISION.resultProjection: Opened components, source consumption, frozen revision, genealogy, and replay agree.
stateProjection: published positions, event effects, genealogy, retained composition revision

TRACE-CONTAINER-COMMAND-ATOMIC.finiteDomain: Nested finite containers, exact package/serial rows, one whole-container transfer, and blocked reservation case.
TRACE-CONTAINER-COMMAND-ATOMIC.resultProjection: Whole-container movement preserves every contained physical identity and fails atomically when bound.
stateProjection: contained positions, container metadata, event result

TRACE-CORRECTION-TRANSFORMATION-PACKAGIN.finiteDomain: Finite issue/transfer/pack/unpack/transform/scrap roots with append-only correction chains.
TRACE-CORRECTION-TRANSFORMATION-PACKAGIN.resultProjection: Corrections retain original history; packaging/transformation conserve declared vectors and genealogy.
stateProjection: published event history, current positions, traceability relations

TRACE-COUNT-ABSOLUTE-OBSERVATION-MOVEMEN.finiteDomain: One exact lot counted four to three while other movement remains intact.
TRACE-COUNT-ABSOLUTE-OBSERVATION-MOVEMEN.resultProjection: Lifecycle, discrepancy, target, revision, and replay agree.

TRACE-DIMENSION-RECLASSIFICATION-CONSERV.finiteDomain: Finite one-to-many and many-to-one status/owner/custodian/dimension reclassifications with reservation blockers.
TRACE-DIMENSION-RECLASSIFICATION-CONSERV.resultProjection: Declared dimensions change while item/package/measurement totals remain conserved.

TRACE-FUNGIBILITY-MOVEMENT-IDENTITY.finiteDomain: Revision-frozen pool issue and transfer over finite member items/lots with replay and reservation conflicts.
TRACE-FUNGIBILITY-MOVEMENT-IDENTITY.resultProjection: Member identity, exact basis contribution, conservation, reservation protection, and replay agree.
stateProjection: member positions, pool contribution, event and allocation results

TRACE-ISSUE-MANY-FEFO-SHORTFALL.finiteDomain: Two dated lots, one two-unit FEFO issue, one impossible 100-unit request.
TRACE-ISSUE-MANY-FEFO-SHORTFALL.resultProjection: Lot choice, allocation, decrement, rejection, and replay agree.

TRACE-LOT-METADATA-CORRECTION.finiteDomain: One item-scoped lot master, append-only metadata correction, exact replay, and cross-item rejection.
TRACE-LOT-METADATA-CORRECTION.resultProjection: Lot identity, effective metadata, correction provenance, and replay agree.
stateProjection: effective lot master and retained correction event

TRACE-MIGRATION-PLAN-PUBLISH-REPAIR.finiteDomain: One catalogue, one opening, one manifest, changed plan, three crashes.
TRACE-MIGRATION-PLAN-PUBLISH-REPAIR.resultProjection: Dry-run, publication, replay, rejection, repair, and terminal manifest agree.

TRACE-PROJECTION-INDEX-SCALE-LOCALITY.finiteDomain: One 1,000-lot baseline and one 5,000-lot item, exact indexed reads and FIFO allocation.
TRACE-PROJECTION-INDEX-SCALE-LOCALITY.resultProjection: Published indexes rebuild exactly and write/read/allocation growth remains bounded near-linear.

TRACE-PUBLIC-HELPER-DIRECT-EXECUTION.finiteDomain: Direct exact-value, collection, amount-group, traceability, durable validation/materialization, and cutover-precondition inputs.
TRACE-PUBLIC-HELPER-DIRECT-EXECUTION.resultProjection: Direct public helper outputs or fail-closed validation results agree with the mapped family invariants.

TRACE-PUBLIC-SURFACE-CALLGRAPH-COMPLETIO.finiteDomain: Direct successful and fail-closed execution of every public implementation body that previously lacked a compiler-resolved tested call-chain witness.
TRACE-PUBLIC-SURFACE-CALLGRAPH-COMPLETIO.resultProjection: Every mapped implementation body is reached from a registered Vitest callback and either returns the expected finite result or rejects malformed input without publishing state.
stateProjection: compiler-resolved tested call graph and direct public observations

TRACE-READ-SNAPSHOT-COHERENCE.finiteDomain: One published catalogue, one item, two lots, one frozen snapshot, and one later successful receipt.
TRACE-READ-SNAPSHOT-COHERENCE.resultProjection: Every summary, lot, container, package, and worldRevision observation remains bound to the first published world after a later publication.
stateProjection: one readWorld call followed by synchronous frozen snapshot observations

TRACE-RECEIVE-MANY-PUBLISH-REPLAY.finiteDomain: Two receipt lines, two lots, nine units, exact retry.
TRACE-RECEIVE-MANY-PUBLISH-REPLAY.resultProjection: Effects, total, event identity, revision, and replay agree.

TRACE-RECORDED-DEFICIT-REFINEMENT.finiteDomain: One item revision, one location-level deficit position, bounded issue quantities, one late receipt, two operation identities, Record and Reject modes.
TRACE-RECORDED-DEFICIT-REFINEMENT.resultProjection: First execution and exact replay return the same explicit deficit amount, position, primary shortfall, receipt revision, and event identity; changed intent is rejected.

TRACE-RESERVATION-EXACT-ISSUE-SCRAP.finiteDomain: Finite broad/exact reservations, allocation, exact issue/scrap, consume replay, and conflict rejection.
TRACE-RESERVATION-EXACT-ISSUE-SCRAP.resultProjection: No over-reservation or double consume; destructive effects are explicit and exact.
stateProjection: reservation book, physical positions, issue/scrap event results

TRACE-SNAPSHOT-SUPERSEDED-WORKFLOW.finiteDomain: Two unresolved legacy workflow rows, one source snapshot revision, one fence, one disposition per row, one atomic migration publication, and bounded post-fence resume attempts.
TRACE-SNAPSHOT-SUPERSEDED-WORKFLOW.resultProjection: Compiled plan, dry-run, applying manifest, terminal compact manifest, and exact retry retain the same sorted dispositions while operation/event count excludes every disposed row; post-fence legacy admission rejects.

TRACE-STOCK-EXACT-TRANSFER.finiteDomain: One exact package revision transferred between two locations before opening.
TRACE-STOCK-EXACT-TRANSFER.resultProjection: Global amount and package identity are conserved across exact transfer.
stateProjection: source and destination exact package positions

TRACE-TRANSFER-LIFECYCLE.finiteDomain: Two otherwise identical concurrent transfers sharing one transit location, including prepare, dispatch, partial/full receipt, release, replay, and changed-intent rejection.
TRACE-TRANSFER-LIFECYCLE.resultProjection: Transfer result reports exact lifecycle state and received/remainder quantities; retry is observationally identical and cannot cross transfer identities.

TRACE-TRANSFER-MANY-FEFO-ATOMIC.finiteDomain: One three-unit FEFO transfer between two locations.
TRACE-TRANSFER-MANY-FEFO-ATOMIC.resultProjection: Source decrement equals destination increment; replay and repair agree.

TRACE-TRANSFORMATION-DEFINITION-READ-PLA.finiteDomain: Three exact item form revisions, four retained transformation revisions, one current stock row, and one published-world plan.
TRACE-TRANSFORMATION-DEFINITION-READ-PLA.resultProjection: Definition reads keep exact revision identity, and planning reports exact required and available vectors from one unchanged published world.
stateProjection: published catalogue snapshot, exact current positions, and read-only transformation plan
